name: LegacyIntentLoader
description: Load old IntentionLSTM(num_classes=8) checkpoint via IntentionLSTM class, wrap output to [batch, 1, 7] with horizon dim and 8→7 truncation
rationale: IntentionLSTM class still exists in ai/models.py
All 22 checkpoint keys match IntentionLSTM(num_classes=8) exactly
Only output dimension differs (8 vs 7 directions)
8th class (index 7) is safely discarded as _DIRECTION_STEPS has only 0-6
risks: 8th class may have semantic meaning - truncation loses it
